Comment: Cool graphical puzzle to warm up some string manipulation and pattern recognition.

Anyway, looks good to me!

This is a sequel to ASCII Tennis Racket (which is MY contribution, so this shouldn't be considered as copying)

Thanks for approving @jonas_melo! I'm glad you liked my clash, and hopefully, my simple solution teaches you the mighty power of simplistic code and that you lose your aura from overthinking solutions (okay now I'm acting weird 😅).
